likaku-mck-ppt-design-skill-root.description: Create professional, consultant-grade PowerPoint presentations from scratch using MckEngine (python-pptx wrapper) with McKinsey-style design. Use when user asks to create slides, pitch decks, business presentations, strategy decks, quarterly reviews, board meeting slides, or any professional PPTX. AI calls eng.cover(), eng.donut(), eng.timeline() etc — 67 high-level methods across 12 categories (structure, data, framework, comparison, narrative, timeline, team, charts, images, advanced viz, dashboards, visual storytelling), consistent typography, zero file-corruption issues, BLOCK_ARC native…
